title: Audit: localStorage leaks and unintentional usage
description: Use critique-waves to audit ALL localStorage/sessionStorage usage. Ensure nothing saves or reads from localStorage unless intentional and documented.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Create tracker.md with goal of 6 consecutive passes
Run waves of 3 parallel agents checking: (1) all localStorage usage, (2) all sessionStorage usage, (3) logout/auth handlers
Continue until 6 consecutive passes or issues found

notes: CODE REVIEW ONLY - NO BROWSER. FORBIDDEN: any localStorage.setItem/getItem not in useVisitorId.ts or explicitly approved list. REQUIRED: all localStorage keys documented, logout clears user data. ALLOWED keys: songscript_visitor_id, songscript_welcome_shown, songscript_migrate_on_signup, songscript_signup_display_name. Any other key = FAIL. AUDIT RESULT: ALL PASS - 3 parallel agents verified: 12 localStorage usages all approved, 0 sessionStorage in app code, logout/auth handlers properly clean up.
